Customer Reviews
Tammy Lundy

"It's fun to sort through all the stuff and find treasures but.....they have 1 Hispanic man that works at the registers that refuses to wait on white people and he doesn't try and hide it or act busy suddenly to disguise his distaste for white people. No he makes hand motions to shoo you away if you approach him and turns his head away from you. It was the first time I've ever been discriminated against and it was hurtful and left me confused as to why he dislikes us so much?"

clemente ruiz

"They said the yunk of mine is treasure for someone else well in this store you can find some bad stuff but you can definitely find good things even new ones,some brand new clothes with the tags on it and some good used tools that still good to work and the better part is the prices very very sheap"

Kevin Baker

"A few hidden treasures. Lots of trash leftover from the stores, but you can find a few gems if you look long enough. Large plastic bins with leftovers dumped randomly. Sold by weight or item. Pick carefully beware broken glass."

Steve Hook

"This place is not my cup of tea. You line up along the walls while employees roll out carts of items. Once they are all rolled out, they give the go ahead and everyone makes a mad dash to grab what they want. It's like black Friday at a thrift store."

Customer Reviews
Tracy E

"This place is trash. They only change the clothing bins once per day and they literally mix trash in with the clothes. It’s disgusting. Half of the stuff in the clothing bins is trash. The clothes in the bins are dirty, ripped, and gross. This is why I go to the goodwill outlets in Denver or Minneapolis."

Your Closet

"This place is horrible place to even think of entering. This place is full of scammers trying to sell you something that does not even belong to them. Not only that the customer service is also horrible they are racist and don’t care. I tried to get something out of someone’s cart (the scammer) and he came up to me yelling “HEY HEY HEY that’s my cart you can’t take that”. The employee comes backing him up telling me that it’s against store policies to take something out of someone’s cart. Later when I was leaving I confronted the employees of the people trying to sell things within the store and all they do is stare at me in annoyance like they are taking part of the scammers plan. Sorry but this store is not worth going it’s filled with scammers and bad customer service. If you are looking for a place to be scammed and mistreated come to this Goodwill outlet because I can assure you that you will get that treatment."

Tammy Ivey

"This place use to be a good place to go to get some good items reasonably priced and didn't mind having to take the time to seach through the bins but the price per pound went up and up and there seems to be alot of trash broken things anymore you have to search through- not worth it anymore"

Kali Coates

"One of the cheapest bins stores I’ve been to and not nearly as dirty as the bad reviews will make you think. Only complaint is that they changed over like half the store at once and it took forever. Would not be as much of a hinderance to shoppers if you did smaller sections at a time."

Note: Store policies and restock rules can change. We recommend calling ahead to confirm the most up-to-date information.
